description: This file defines the TestTracing class responsible for capturing, managing, and saving trace events during test execution in Playwright. It includes methods for starting/stopping traces, handling trace events, and merging trace files.

classes.name: TestTracing
classes.description: Manages trace collection, storage, and merging during test execution, including handling trace events, errors, and attachments.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes and starts trace recording based on provided options.

methods.name: stopIfNeeded
methods.description: Stops trace recording, finalizes, and saves the trace data.

methods.name: appendForError
methods.description: Appends an error event to the trace.

methods.name: appendStdioToTrace
methods.description: Records stdout or stderr output into the trace.

methods.name: appendBeforeActionForStep
methods.description: Logs a 'before' event for a test step.

methods.name: appendAfterActionForStep
methods.description: Logs an 'after' event for a test step.
